propositions: The seven mechanism kinds partition the definition surface; each site yields exactly one (kind, name) entry, enforced per-kind not as scalar sum.
The marker idiom `# mechanism-ok: <kind> <name> — <reason>` admits new mechanisms, with name field supporting whitespace by splitting on separators with whitespace on both sides.
Name fields for config_key and feature_flag must be section-qualified as `<section>.<key>` to distinguish identically-named entries across sections in _SECTIONS.
The parse_marker function previously truncated multi-word names by splitting on the first None (whitespace), causing YAML-step ci_gate entries (226/257) to never be justifiable.
The --check mode exits non-zero for unjustified new mechanisms; --update-stale refuses to write when new>0 or increased>0; --lock mode is omitted because the baseline has no locked limit.
The ratchet detects mechanism additions per (kind, name) keyed pairs across 7 kinds with baseline at .github/mechanism-baseline.json, enabling shrink-only enforcement of the mechanism surface.
